description.en: Toasted and full of attitude. Hang this sun-browned accent right on your phone and trust it to absorb the digital noise. Flip your screen over, take a deep breath, and maybe it’s time for a warm, buttery slice of toast. Just one, though—gotta stay low on carbs.
